title: Our story
headline:
A love of animals.
A legacy of care.
introduction: Critter Creek's story begins with Milly Olson's lifelong love of animals, sparked by her first dog, Toby.
alt: Black swans beside the pond at Critter Creek.

sections.heading: It started with Toby
sections.body: Milly saw animals as friends, companions, and family. Together with her husband, Dick, she founded Critter Creek Sanctuary Ranch in Palm City, Florida.

sections.heading: A place to call home
sections.body: The ranch's mission brings together sanctuary, education, and conservation: caring for animals, helping people learn about nature, and preserving wildlife and natural habitats.

sections.heading: Become part of the story
sections.body: Arrange a visit. Bring your group's questions. Volunteer your time. Support the animals. There are many ways to connect with the life of the ranch and help its work continue.
